agent_explanation: Single bouncing ball with e=0.9 hits floor between steps 62 and 63 and gains energy: speed jumps from 10.27 m/s inbound to 12.33 outbound, raising total energy from ~57.76 J to 81.03 J, exceeding allowed 68.5 J. This indicates floor collision adds energy instead of dissipating (restitution handling bug / velocity reflection error amplifying energy).
